outcome: Clients and client details read live client groups and workspace contacts
acceptance_criteria: `/clients` against live shows one row per group and one per ungrouped project, groups first, in the order returned — verify: open `/clients` as live-lead on port 4970 (API_ORIGIN Django 8010) and compare the rows with `curl` of `GET /api/v1/clients` with the same session.

A group row shows `project_count` as PROJECTS and links to `/clients/<key>`; an ungrouped project row links to `/clients/<case_id>` — verify: page shows the rows; read the `href` of the first group and first project link.

A project with `billing: "unknown"` reads "Unknown" in the billing cell and state tag, never "Set" or "Missing"; `recorded` reads "Set"; `needed` reads "Billing contact missing" — verify: mock fixtures and `tests/clients.test.tsx` cases for the three values.
A group with `contacts_needed` of 2 reads "2 billing contacts needed" with the missing tag; `0` reads "None needed" — verify: component test.

No OWED column, no owed text on phone cards, no money panel and no "blocked" callout appears on `/clients` or `/clients/<id>`; no "0" or "₦0" appears as an amount — verify: component tests assert absence, and open both pages at 1440 and 390.

"Show more" fetches the next group page, then the next project page, and never repeats a row — verify: mock `many` state test with two group pages and two project pages; request log shows the `clients_page` and `page` values used.
`/clients?billing=needed` and `?q=<text>` send those query values on the request — verify: unit test of the request URL in `api.ts` tests.
`/clients/<group key>` shows the label, its projects with billing tags and links to `/projects/<case_id>`, and "Show more" while `next_page` is set — verify: mock group fixture with two pages.
`/clients/<case_id>` shows billing contacts (customer, name, email, role) read only, a separate "Project contacts" block, and the sample label when `sample` is true — verify: mock workspace fixture.

"Show history" lists versions newest first from `contacts/history?purpose=billing`, pages with "Show more", and a failed history call shows a retry without clearing the page — verify: test with a 503 on history.

The billing contact form is visible and disabled with the reason "Waiting for the evidence picker and the backend answer."; clicking Save and pressing Enter send no request — verify: test asserts `fetch` calls contain no `PUT /billing-contact` and no `POST /clients/*/contacts`; `grep -rn "billing-contact" frontend/src` finds no live call.

Wrong user: a 404 or 403 on a group key or a case id shows `ClientNoAccess` with no name, title or contact in the page or the tab title — verify: mock 404 and 403 tests. Wrong tenant: a case id from another tenant returns 404 from Django 8010 and shows the same state — verify: open it as live-none.

A 401 on either page shows the signed-out state with a return path to the same URL; a 503 or network failure shows "We couldn't load the clients/this client. Your work is safe; nothing was changed." with a working Retry — verify: tests with injected failures.
Invalid input: `/clients?billing=bogus` is not sent on the request (the filter is ignored) and the list loads; a 400 or 422 reply shows the error card — verify: unit test.
A group key with special characters (`/`, `%`) is sent URL-encoded once, not twice — verify: test on the request path.

The mock's four clients operations validate against the live contract schemas, and a deliberately wrong shape fails the validator — verify: `tests/clients-mock.test.ts` updated, in the style of `tests/mock-live-me.test.ts`.
The v7 mock still serves the other screens; design review of `/clients` and `/clients/<id>` works with `npm run mock` on 4971 — verify: open both pages on 4970 against the mock.
Layout stays on the approved boards at 1440 and 390 apart from the listed conflicts — verify: `design.py check` passes and the fidelity run (one run, layout changed) shows only the listed exceptions.

`src/api/client.ts` and `src/api/schema.d.ts` are unchanged unless named in `build.md` as a separate commit; `delivery/checks.sh`, `delivery/config.json`, `delivery/merge-policy.json` are unchanged — verify: `git diff --stat origin/main`.

risk.rationale: Medium. The change is read-only and conforms to the approved design. It is still a cross-layer contract change, and the meaning of "client" changes from a record to a group in src/features/clients and in the route id. Per-record access applies to the reads. The high-risk billing-contact write is excluded. Surfaces: ui, api, contract-change, and product-decision for the B4 and B5 defaults. Product acceptance is required because the client sees a changed list, a changed detail page and a disabled contact form.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
